relationships.subject: PGDHi
relationships.evidence_quote: with a significant reduction in Chemokine (C-C motif) ligand 7(CCL7), C-X-C motif chemokine ligand 10 (CXCL10), Chemokine (C-C motif) ligand 4 (CCL4), Vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF), Interleukin-27 (IL27), and Interleukin-2 (IL2) cytokines

relationships.subject: PGDHi
relationships.evidence_quote: 15-PGDH inhibition reduced the abundance of 15-PGDH+CD200+ cells by increasing local PGE2 concentrations in aged and injured cartilage

key_findings: Systemic or intra-articular 15-PGDH inhibition (SW033291) regenerated hyaline articular cartilage in aged and post-traumatic OA mice and reduced OA-associated pain.
Regeneration reflects a shift away from 15-PGDH+CD200+ hypertrophic-like chondrocytes toward ECM-synthesizing chondrocytes, via raised PGE2, not progenitor proliferation.
